title: I really like it, but
body:
It doesn’t have a habit scorecard feature.

That wouldnbe a cool feature to have, because right now its just an implementation intention app. Also it should somehow allow you to integrate beliefes.

I have made a list of what the habit scorecard festure should have (looked around conjure is the closest match I found so far):

Core Features

Habit Scorecard Creation
Ability to list daily habits with timestamps.
Options to categorize each habit as positive (+), negative (-), or neutral (=).
User-friendly interface to add, edit, and delete habits throughout the day.
Integration with Apple Watch
Seamless syncing with Apple Health to import data relevant to habits (e.g., exercise, standing hours, heart rate data that might indicate stress or relaxation).
Trigger notifications or reminders based on certain activity thresholds or lack thereof (e.g., reminding to stand or take a break from screen time).
Data Analysis and Export
Tools to analyze habits over time, identifying patterns and potential triggers for negative habits. (Chatgpt integration to analyse the text in each habit to show patterns, give summaries and insight)
Capability to export data in common formats (e.g., CSV, PDF, excel) for deeper analysis or sharing with professionals like therapists or coaches.
User Customization and Settings
Customizable views to focus on daily, weekly, or monthly habit tracking
Customizable dashboard to view daily progress, weekly summaries, and monthly trends.
Settings to adjust how habits are displayed and categorized, based on user preferences. You are able to name lists and organise them. For example you can have a list for workmeetings or swimming and keep track of that.
Have a constant view of beliefe at all times, probably on top of the app as your prewritten beliefes are scrolling by all times you use the app. 
Settings to adjust how habits are displayed and categorized, based on user preferences.
Different themes or display modes (e.g., dark mode, minimalist layout) for user comfort and accessibility.
Optional widgets for quick views of habit status on phone home screens or watch faces.
You should be also able to „combine habit lists, scorecards” to build bigger combinations after a list becomes automatic
Privacy and Data Security
Ensure high-level encryption for user data both in transit and at rest.
Compliance with privacy regulations (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA as applicable) to safeguard user data.
Additional Features

Social Sharing Options
Optional feature to share progress with friends or a community for motivation and support.
Ability to connect with other users for accountability. They could rate eachothers lists of habits compared in effectivness to beliefe.
Gamification Elements
Implement points, badges, and levels to encourage habit improvement.
Animations, shaking feedback… ect to make the experience more rewarding
Rewards for achieving milestones or replacing negative habits with positive ones.
Integration of a Pomodoro-style timer with alternating focus sessions (25 minutes) and breaks (5 minutes), where users can manage their lists during the breaks.
AI Insights
Utilize machine learning to offer personalized insights based on user data, suggesting the most impactful habit changes.
Predictive analytics to warn users about potential fallbacks to negative habits based on historical data and trends.
Ai could even determine how well habits aligned with beliefs
Notifacitions and reminders
